description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling BDF font files, including font properties, glyphs, and font metrics.

methods.name: bdf_load_font
methods.description: Loads a BDF font from a stream into a font structure.

methods.name: bdf_free_font
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a BDF font.

methods.name: bdf_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves a font property by name.

methods.name: bdf_get_font_property
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property of a font by name.
